$\mathbb C[\mathbf c,t]$ (or $\mathbb C[\mathbf c,u,t]$ for the differential complex).
The displayed family traces are finite-free traces over that ring.
At a specified complex coefficient value they specialize to the ordinary
finite-dimensional fibre trace; this follows by evaluating every entry of
the same multiplication matrix.  The fixed original polynomial is retained
at its marked coefficient value.  In the arbitrary-ring construction,
the family base is $R[t]$.
